It independently constructs the normalized three-outcome base law and its IID infinite product, and checks that the distinct true vectors (1,1,0) and (1,-1,0) induce that same law. Full all-sample unique-MLE existence is checked mathematically in REPORT.md: maximize the positive likelihood on the disc; the maximizer is unique, is never its center for a positive sample because the base mass sqrt(2)/4 is irrational, and therefore lifts to exactly one full vector. Finite sample domains ensure measurability. Probability-limit uniqueness then guarantees that at least one of these true vectors is a genuine inconsistent target. This part is an independent mathematical witness check, not a new compiled proof of the all-sample argmax theorem.
